messages:
Jules: Follow-up on checkpointed streaming retries. Proposal: emit a tiny ASCII progress token mid-stream so clients can request a resume instead of blind retry.

Priya: How small are we talking? needs to be verifiable and cheap to parse by proxies.

Jules: e.g. `x-rw-prog: v1;tok=452;kid=kw1;sig=Zx3` (max ~80 bytes). HMAC over request id+tok.

Ethan: OK for proxies. Important: define semantics clearly: token refers to model output token index at safe boundary only. No partial token resumes.

Jules: Exactly. We only emit at sentence/EOS boundaries. SDKs must forward the exact token string back on reconnect.

Cara: Billing: if we resume, how to avoid double-charge for tokens already sent?

Ethan: Billing service will accept checkpoint sig as a watermark. If resumed with the same sig, bill only tokens after tok. Need a stable canonical tokenization mapping across variants.

Priya: What if model variant changes (quantized vs full) and token index semantics diverge? gateway should try compatible variants then fall back to full restart with HTTP 412 error if none match.

Jules: Add route flag `emit_progress_tokens=true` default off. Gradual rollout.

Cara: Observability hooks?

Ethan: Metrics: `edge.prog.emit_total`, `edge.prog.resume_ok`, `edge.prog.resume_fallback`. Tracing: span tag `retry.resume_checkpoint_used`.

Priya: Security: KMS-rotated HMAC, include kid and short timestamp. Keep token blinding minimal to avoid PII.

ops-bot: Deployed branch `edge-checkpoint-mini` to staging (rev c9d2). Canary routes enabled.

Cara: Add SDK snippet to RFC: receive trailer, store, POST /v1/resume { checkpoint }. Server validates sig and either resumes or returns 412.

Jules: I'll draft the RFC extension with header schema, examples, and a small state diagram. Thanks everyone.
